scientific_question: Among SAME heldout physical site x taxon pairs detected in both winter and summer, does the solar-over-civil-clock heldout predictive gain change direction? Is a pooled winter-positive result explainable solely by taxa/site composition?

collapse_order: average per-event log-score gain within site x taxon x season x year
average across represented heldout years within same site x taxon x season (equal year weighting)
retain only site x taxon cells with >=5 total scored detections in EACH season
compute each matched site x taxon winter-minus-summer difference
compute equal-pair mean, equal-physical-site mean of within-site pair means, and equal-taxon mean of taxon-wise pair means
matched_cell_rule.pair_weighting: equal site×taxon cell, then report site-balanced and taxon-balanced companion estimands
matched_cell_rule.taxon_primary: ALL training-admitted species and coarse IDs on common site×taxon support, with no taxonomic cherry-picking
matched_cell_rule.taxon_secondary: named wild mammal-like taxa only; no confirmatory inference and no rescue of original v2

nonclaims: Even same taxon at same camera site across seasons does not control changes in detectability or animal behaviour
Pairing does not establish effect of photoperiod, predator interactions or true activity rates
The postoutcome alternative is descriptive and cannot validate the original all-seasons-positive primary
Matched support may differ from and be nonrepresentative of original heldout detection population
Taxonomic labels may be coarse and camera monitoring effort uncalibrated
No original v0, v1, v2 or qualified ODSP statistical route is reclassified
stop_conditions: Source MD5, source v2 parser, original training/test fitted counts, original heldout overall winter/summer gains or scored n differ from pinned original
Fewer than 8 matched site×taxon pairs with >=5 scored events per season
Unknown species column or unverified changes to source grading
Any post-result change of cell inclusion threshold, site roster or season grouping
